latest_final: Kameda and Umio were influential leaders of rival political factions, and their argument concerned which faction would control the government. Kameda later murdered Umio; the killing was connected to their political rivalry and helped remove an obstacle to Kameda’s faction ultimately prevailing. Kameda secretly buried Umio, concealing the murder and leaving Umio without a proper funeral—a dishonorable fate. Kameda himself was cremated, leaving his body in fragments. After both men had died, people compared their fates and took Umio’s dishonorable burial, contrasted with Kameda’s treatment, as a sign that Umio had lost their struggle.
